value.rationale: A sharp first failure threshold on a canonical Fano geometry: loss of one or two incidences exactly reduces the second mod-two Betti rank, while three deletions exhibit precisely 84 nonadditive rank rebounds classified by meaningful induced matching geometry. The 28 strongest exceptions coincide with the known central orbit of an independent exchange graph, giving a motivated finite exact invariant without asserting a larger theorem.
